senses.gloss: जृ vt. 1P (pres. जरति) To make low, to humiliate.

जॄ vi. 4P or 9P, 10U (pp. जीर्ण; pres. जीर्यति, जृणाति, जरयति-ते) 1. To grow old, to decay, to wear out, Bt.ix.41; 2. to be consumed, to perish, जेरुराशा दशास्यस्य Bt.xiv.112; 3. to be digested, उदरे चाजरत्रन्ये तस्य पातालसंनिभे Bt.xv.50.
